{"metadata":{"description":"DSH 升级守卫：升级前兼容盘点 / 升级后契约扫描 / 启动冒烟（DeepSeek Harness 插件）","id":"gh:1393327427","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-upgrade-guard","slug":"wqx11235/dsh-upgrade-guard","topics":["compatibility","contract-scan","deepseek-harness","desktop","dsh","dsh-plugin","electron","plugin","smoke-test","upgrade"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH 升级守卫：升级前兼容盘点 / 升级后契约扫描 / 启动冒烟（DeepSeek Harness 插件）"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-upgrade-guard · upgrade safety net for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> **升级前**盘点插件兼容性 → **升级后**扫描已知破坏性契约 → **切换端口前**先启动冒烟，不通过就别切。
> 中文文档：README.zh.md"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Stop "upgrading DeepSeek Harness" from turning into "one upgrade, one broken plugin"."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness (dsh) ships fast, and every release can change a contract that plugins depend on. T"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"he same class of failure keeps recurring:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| Upgrade | Root cause | Symptom |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| 0.1.1 → 0.1.2 | `client-modules` module table got strict | page shows `Failed to load plugins` |
|"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" 0.1.2 → 0.1.5 | service access contract got strict (missing `inject` throws) | 31 plugins pending i"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"n a chain |
| 0.1.6 → 0.1.7 | service `settingsScope` removed/renamed | 26 plugins pending |
| 0.1.7"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"-alpha.1 | `ui-primitives` icon renamed (`IconXxx14` → `IconXxxRegular`, no alias) | `Minified React"},{"id":"p7s5","text":" error #130` |
| 0.1.7 | session message v4 `source` contract | a run fails after finishing: `format"},{"id":"p7s6","text":" v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind` |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"This plugin turns the diagnosis of each such incident into a reusable check."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Three actions"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Action | When | What it does |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| **Contract scan** (offline, seconds) | anytime / after upgrading | scans installed plugins against"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" a catalogue of known-breaking contracts: removed service names, old session-message `source` shape,"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" references to `ui-primitives` exports that do not exist |
| **Preflight** (online, 10–40 s) | **bef"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ore** upgrading | for each plugin: declared compatibility range, newest version on npm, whether it s"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"upports the target → "can we upgrade + what must move with it + what to disable" |
| **Boot smoke** "},{"id":"p11s6","text":"(30–90 s) | **before** switching ports | boots a throwaway host on a test port, reads its boot summa"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"ry (`SKIPPED` / `DEGRADED` / `PENDING` / real culprit), probes each client bundle for reachability, "},{"id":"p11s8","text":"kills the test host afterwards |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Compatibility (why it works on both web and desktop)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Designed to keep working across 0.1.x and 0.2.x, and on both the web profile and the official deskto"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"p app
(**verified on desktop `0.2.1-rc.5` and `0.2.2-rc.1`**, Electron 44.7.0 / Node 24.21.0):"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **Zero `@deepseek-ai/*` imports.** The host half imports only Node builtins plus the `webServer` s"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ervice. The largest historical failure class is "host changed a package/service contract while the p"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"lugin still imported the old thing", so this plugin imports none.
- **No hardcoded machine paths.** "},{"id":"p14s4","text":"The profile is found by walking up from the plugin's own location; the host binary/install root is d"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"erived from `process.argv[1]`; `ui-primitives` is searched through several candidates. The same file"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"s run unchanged in `profiles/web` and `profiles/desktop`.
- **`peerDependencies` declared as `*`, al"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"l `optional`.** dsh 0.1.7+ ships a peer-compatibility gate that silently skips bundles declaring a n"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"arrow range (e.g. `browser-skill-dsh-plugin@0.3.1` requires `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools: ^0.1.5-rc.3` an"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"d gets skipped on 0.2.0-rc.2). A `*` + optional declaration is the declaration shape that survives t"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"hat gate.
- **Client half follows the 0.1.2+ client contract.** `exports.inject = ['slots']` is decl"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"ared, and slots are reached via `ctx.slots` with a `ctx.get('slots')` fallback, so both the older pr"},{"id":"p14s12","text":"oxy and the newer restricted proxy work. It only `require`s `react` (a platform seed word), so the t"},{"id":"p14s13","text":"ightened module table cannot hit it.
- **Electron aware.** On the desktop app `process.execPath` is "},{"id":"p14s14","text":"the app binary; smoke spawns with `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` so no second app window appears. Inside a"},{"id":"p14s15","text":" packaged `app.asar` runtime smoke reports `UNSUPPORTED` (with alternatives) instead of failing myst"},{"id":"p14s16","text":"eriously.
- **Honest about the export table.** When the `ui-primitives` copy found on disk differs f"},{"id":"p14s17","text":"rom the running host version, the UI says so, because "export does not exist" conclusions are only a"},{"id":"p14s18","text":"s good as that copy."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Restart the host, hard-refresh the page, then open **设置 → 通用 → 升级守卫**."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### In the UI"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"**Settings → General → Upgrade guard** — three buttons plus a footer that tells you which host/runti"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"me/primitives the result came from:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- **Contract scan** → `⚠ critical N / warn N (scanned M plugins)` + findings
- **Preflight** → `📋 ta"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"rget x.y.z: N plugins, K have updates` + the list
- **Boot smoke** → `✅ PASS` / `❌ FAIL` + key outpu"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"t lines (`ROOT?` / `PENDING` / `SKIPPED` / `DEGRADED` / `BADBUNDLE`)"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Command line (same engine)"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"`--profile` takes a directory **or** a profile name: the desktop app exports `DSH_PROFILE=desktop`
("},{"id":"p24s2","text":"a name) plus `DSH_PROFILE_DIR` (the real path), and both are resolved."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Environment fallbacks: `DSH_HOME` (default `~/.dsh`), `DSH_PROFILE_DIR`, `DSH_PROFILE`, `DSH_PRIMITI"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"VES`, `DSH_ASAR`, `DSH_SMOKE_BIN`, `DSH_SMOKE_PORT`, `DSH_SMOKE_CWD`, `DSH_SMOKE_TIMEOUT`, `DSH_SMOK"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"_ASAR`, `DSH_SMOKE_BIN`, `DSH_SMOKE_PORT`, `DSH_SMOKE_CWD`, `DSH_SMOKE_TIMEOUT`, `DSH_SMOKE_KEEP=1`."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Console output is deliberately English/ASCII (Windows `cmd` at code page 936 garbles UTF-8 Chinese);"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" the Chinese report goes to the `--report` file (default `$DSH_HOME/upgrade-guard/`)."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Where the judgement comes from"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"`KNOWN_RULES` in `lib/guard.mjs` is the catalogue of known-breaking contracts:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"1. **`removed-service`** — services the host removed or renamed (`settingsScope`, `conversationEvent"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"s`, …). Hard references are `critical`; optional `inject([...])` uses are `warn` (the plugin degrade"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"s gracefully), and matches inside comments are skipped to avoid false positives.
2. **`session-sourc"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"e-v4`** — the old session-message `source: { kind: 'plugin', plugin: 'x' }` shape (rejected since 0."},{"id":"p29s5","text":"1.7).
3. **`missing-host-export`** — client code referencing a member absent from the host's `ui-pri"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"mitives` export table (e.g. the `IconXxx14/16` rename). It only throws `React #130` at render time, "},{"id":"p29s7","text":"so this is a static early warning.
4. **`pinned-exact`** — a plugin pinned to an exact version in th"},{"id":"p29s8","text":"e profile (`"x": "1.2.3"`), so it can never follow the host (real case: a plugin pinned and stuck 19"},{"id":"p29s9","text":"1.2.3"`), so it can never follow the host (real case: a plugin pinned and stuck 19 versions behind)."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"**Every new incident adds one rule** — that is the only way this plugin grows, and the reason it get"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"s sharper over time."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Limits (read these)"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
